say:0:1830418001:1.text: Jordan Black was here, with the whole family's ashes. Lovely view, but the wind blew off one of my ears.
say:0:1830418001:1.source_cn: 约克冬·布莱克到此一游，带着全家骨灰来的。风景不错，就...

say:1:1830418002:1.text: Edith West was here. Carved this for my husband. He fell apart, so he couldn't make it.
say:1:1830418002:1.source_cn: 伊迪丝·韦斯特，到此一游。帮丈夫刻的，他散架了，来不了。

say:2:1830418003:1.text: Eileen was here with the love of my life.
say:2:1830418003:1.source_cn: 艾琳到此一游，和我最爱的人。

say:3:1830418004:1.text: Sylviah was here. Sylviah and Eileen, together in death forever.
say:3:1830418004:1.source_cn: 西尔维亚到此一游。西尔维亚和艾琳永远死在一起。

say:4:1830418005:1.text: Humphrey Cross checking in. I owed a debt in life and settled it in death. We're even.
say:4:1830418005:1.source_cn: 汉弗莱·克罗斯，打卡。活着欠债，死了还愿。两清。

say:5:1830418006:1.text: Crawford Huxley was here. Also found an ear. If it's yours, I left it under the tree.
say:5:1830418006:1.source_cn: 克劳福德·赫胥黎，到此一游。顺便捡到一只耳朵，谁丢的？...

say:6:1830418007:1.text: Crydon Moan was... Forget it, that's too much to carve. I was here.
say:6:1830418007:1.source_cn: 哭曼·莫恩，到此……算了，字太多，刻不下。总之我来了。
